20260706.explanation: 請對方稍等時，用 give + 人 + 時間；wait 後面要接 for + 人。
20260706.pattern: Give me + 一段時間. / Wait for me + 一段時間.

20260706.explanation: 調整設定用 adjust settings；多項裝置設定通常用複數。
20260706.pattern: Let me adjust my + 複數名詞.

20260706.explanation: 詢問現在能否聽清楚，用 Can you hear me clearly?；clearly 修飾 hear。
20260706.pattern: Can you + 動詞 + 受詞 + 副詞?

20260706.explanation: 回顧當時天氣要用過去式 was；extremely 修飾形容詞 hot。
20260706.pattern: The weather was + 程度副詞 + 形容詞.

20260706.explanation: 預測颱風路徑用 be going to + 原形動詞；地名前通常不加 the。
20260706.pattern: It is going to pass through + 地名.

20260706.explanation: notice 後可接 that 子句描述觀察到的事；that 可省略。
20260706.pattern: I just noticed (that) + 主詞 + 過去式動詞.

20260706.explanation: 描述可能的原因，用 cause + 問題；avoid cause this reason 這種重複表達。
20260706.pattern: Maybe + 原因 + caused + 問題.

20260706.explanation: 關心某人適應得如何，用 How is + 人 + doing?；staff member 是一名員工。
想做某事用 feel like + V-ing；feel want 不是自然搭配。
主詞是事情時，用 It surprised me；更早的想法用 had never thought。
20260706.pattern: It surprised me because I had never thought that + 子句.

20260709.explanation: 調整設備設定用 adjust my settings；settings 通常是複數。
20260709.pattern: Let me adjust my + 複數名詞.

20260709.explanation: 檢查連線時用 Can you hear me clearly?；clearly 是副詞。
20260709.pattern: Can you + 動詞 + 受詞 + 副詞?

20260709.explanation: 先說核心主詞再補內容；單數 teacher 在一般現在式用 teaches。
20260709.pattern: The teacher teaches + 科目, right?

20260709.explanation: each + 單數名詞接單數動詞；說明授課期間與範圍可用 teaches for / covers。
20260709.pattern: Each + 單數名詞 + 動詞-s + for + 時間 + and + 動詞-s + 內容.

20260709.explanation: need to 後接原形動詞 get；成績高於某數字用 above。
20260709.pattern: We need to get an average score above + 數字.

20260709.explanation: 禮貌提出延期要求，用 Would it be possible to + 動詞；postpone 直接接受詞。
20260709.pattern: Would it be possible to postpone + 活動 + for + 時間?

20260709.explanation: 談之前的預期用 didn't imagine；would 表示從過去看未來的情況。
20260709.pattern: I didn't imagine it would be + 形容詞.

20260709.explanation: 單數 course 接 costs；說每人費用用 per person。
20260709.pattern: This course costs + 金額 + per person.

20260709.explanation: 搬到另一國是 relocate to；reallocate 指重新分配資源。
20260709.pattern: I have been considering + V-ing + to + 地點.

20260709.explanation: 要說帶來好消息，用 bring + 人 + good news；green flag 不能直接代換。
20260709.pattern: I hope I can bring you good news + 時間副詞.

20260907.explanation: 音訊檢查用 Can you hear me clearly?；clearly 修飾 hear。
20260907.pattern: Can you hear me + 副詞?

20260907.explanation: 請牙醫處理牙齒可用 have + 受詞 + 過去分詞；cleaned and checked 平行。
20260907.pattern: I went to + 地點 + to have my + 名詞 + 過去分詞.

20260907.explanation: 引出好消息用 The good news is that + 完整子句。
20260907.pattern: The good news is that + 主詞 + 動詞 + 補語.

20260907.explanation: 接續過去發生的兩件事，兩個動詞都用過去式；運動是 work out。
20260907.pattern: After that, I went to + 地點 + and + 過去式動詞.

20260907.explanation: 生活恢復到某種狀態可說 go back to + 名詞。
20260907.pattern: My life will go back to + 名詞.

20260907.explanation: 忙碌的行程是 hectic schedule；每週三次是 three times a week。
20260907.pattern: I will have a hectic schedule because + 原因.

20260907.explanation: 問設定的溫度，用 What temperature do you set + 設備 + to?。
20260907.pattern: What temperature do you usually set + 設備 + to?

20260907.explanation: a month ago 指明過去，否定句用 didn't + 原形動詞。
20260907.pattern: About + 時間 + ago, I didn't + 原形動詞.

20260907.explanation: start 後可接 V-ing；已開始的習慣用 started。
說明運動前吃點東西，先用 Before + V-ing，再說主要建議。
20260907.pattern: Before + V-ing, you should + 原形動詞 + to + 原形動詞.

20260910.pattern: Yesterday was the + 序數 + day of + 名詞.
I have + 數字 + courses to take.
I've just + 過去分詞 + 受詞.
The workload for + 課程 + is + 形容詞.
I'm still excited about + 名詞.
We went to the same + 學校類型.
It's like a + 形容詞 + job.
Can you hear me clearly, or is there + 名詞?
You're always in + 名詞 + mode.

20260914.pattern: I'll make sure I'm + 形容詞 + for + 活動.
I + 過去式動詞 + on + 過去日期.
In the end, you still need to + 原形動詞.
I worked at + 公司 + in + 城市.
There were + 複數名詞 + we had to + 原形動詞.
I'm not surprised by + 名詞.
I think many + 人群 + use + 工具 + to + 原形動詞.
They want to become + 形容詞.
It's difficult to + 原形動詞 + through + 管道.
We have enough time to + 原形動詞 + 受詞.

20260917.pattern: Do + 主詞 + look + 形容詞?
I've gained + 數量 + knowledge this week.
I need to set aside time to + 原形動詞.
Because I'm taking + 數字 + courses, there is a lot to learn.
It can help me + 原形動詞 + and + 原形動詞.
I still have + 時間 + to + 原形動詞.
There may be only + 數量 + left.
I've started sharing + 事物 + with + 人.
I agree to some extent, maybe about + 百分比.
It's hard to tell + 受詞 + apart.

20260921.explanation: 並列的過去動作時態要一致；do the workout 可簡化成 worked out。
20260921.pattern: I just went to + 地點 + and + 過去式動詞.

20260921.explanation: 同意對方的個人經驗，用 Same here；same to I 不合英文用法。
需要時間恢復的人做主詞，用 I need；不是 it needs。
20260921.pattern: I think I need + 時間 + to + 原形動詞.

20260921.explanation: 描述固定看診頻率用一般現在式；專科醫師前加 a。
20260921.pattern: I see a + 專科醫師 + about once a + 時間單位.

20260921.explanation: 轉述醫師當時說的話用 said；普遍情況可保留現在式 have。
20260921.pattern: The doctor said that + 主詞 + 現在式動詞.

20260921.explanation: thought about 後可接疑問詞子句；從過去視角推測用 would。
20260921.pattern: I never thought about who would + 原形動詞.

20260921.explanation: 說功能需求可用 should be easy to + 動詞；with one hand 是自然搭配。
20260921.pattern: A + 物品 + should be easy to use with + 工具/方式.

20260921.explanation: 比較價格用 for the same price；both A and B 連接兩項。
20260921.pattern: You could buy both + A + and + B + for the same price.

20260921.explanation: 過去的選擇問句用 Why did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。
20260921.pattern: Why did you choose + 物品?

20260921.explanation: 因為某個名詞原因用 because of；過去沒買用 didn't buy。
20260921.pattern: I didn't buy + 物品 + because of + 名詞.

20260924.explanation: 碩士學位是 master's degree；從星期二到星期五用 from ... to ...。
20260924.pattern: I have classes for my + 學位 + from + 星期 + to + 星期.

20260924.explanation: 擔心一件事用 worried that + 子句；到校上課是 go to campus for class。
20260924.pattern: Someone was worried that + 主詞 + would have to + 原形動詞.

20260924.explanation: 描述過去結束時間用 ended；class 比 course 更適合單堂課。
20260924.pattern: The class ended at + 時間.

20260924.explanation: too many 修飾可數複數 courses；attend 接在 to 後用原形。
20260924.pattern: I have too many + 複數名詞 + to + 原形動詞.

20260924.explanation: 一般現在式問句用 Does + 主詞 + have；does 後動詞不加 s。
20260924.pattern: Does your country have laws to + 原形動詞?

20260924.explanation: 表達認為『不太』時，常用 I don't think + 肯定子句。
20260924.pattern: I don't think it is very + 形容詞.

20260924.explanation: 過去是否曾發售，用 Did + 主詞 + ever + 原形動詞；簡答 I don't think so。
20260924.pattern: Did + 公司 + ever release + 產品?

20260924.explanation: 兩項總價相近，用 Together ... cost about the same as ...。
20260924.pattern: Together, + 兩項物品 + would cost about the same as + 比較物.

20260924.explanation: 直接問句中疑問詞 exactly 放在 is 前：What exactly is ...?。
動名詞片語作主詞時接單數 is；擴展人脈用 expand your network。
20260924.pattern: V-ing + 受詞 + is a good opportunity to + 原形動詞.
